== Summary ==
Change crop (before) for [[StarSpeeder 3000 (Errata)]]: the region (156, 52, 404, 116) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[StarSpeeder 3000]] (Original): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/starspeeder3000.gif Holotable commit 3d2c89e] (2024-12-26). The matching after crop is [[:File:V24-L-starspeeder3000-2024-12-30-change-crop-after.png]]. Compared with the image of [[StarSpeeder 3000]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/starspeeder3000.gif commit 3d2c89e]) and [[StarSpeeder 3000 (Errata)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/96a02beca133033b99f3127034c203af0f3d9937/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/starspeeder3000.gif commit 96a02be]).
